\chapter{Introduction}\label{ch:intro}

Prediction markets aggregate dispersed information into prices
\parencite{wolfers2004prediction}. Early evidence from the Iowa Electronic
Markets \parencite{berg2008prediction} suggests they outperform polls.

\section{Motivation}\label{sec:motivation}
We study the efficiency of these markets. See \cref{ch:methods} for the
model and \cref{eq:price} for the pricing equation.
